# VPN Access Guide

Remote access to internal systems requires the GlobalProtect VPN client. Download it from the
software portal and log in with your standard company credentials plus a push notification to
your phone for two-factor approval.

If GlobalProtect fails to connect, first check that your laptop's clock is synced -- a clock
more than five minutes off breaks the certificate handshake. If that doesn't fix it, open a
ticket with the IT helpdesk and include the error code shown in the client's log panel.

VPN sessions time out after ten hours of inactivity and must be re-established the next day.
